experiment: CSE 805 exploratory LR + predicted class × standardized MSP
status_at_design: Original Night and Fog results already known. This comparison and its diagnostic targets were specified before fitting the interaction model.
inputs: Read-only cse805_error_prediction_v1. Reuse the 1600 adverse train images, exact 17 outer and 3 inner grouped assignments, 512 valid training pixels/image (seed 805, inverse inclusion weights). Exclude the original 406 validation images.
model: Same three unweighted, training-standardized continuous features, fixed 19 predicted-class indicators, plus 19 terms: standardized MSP times each predicted-class indicator. All classes receive the same construction. No weather or GT input. Global MSP slope and all class deviations receive L2 regularization as do other coefficients; interpret combined slopes.
fit: lbfgs, max_iter 1000, tol 1e-5, classifier sample weights normalized to mean one within fit. C in [0.01, 0.1, 1.0]; select by mean of 3 inner weighted APs, smaller C for ties within 1e-12. Refit on 16 training groups. No tuning on weather or outer results.
primary_comparison: Interaction versus frozen LR + Class. Equal-group mean accepted error at retrospective near-80% coverage, plus AUROC, AP, AURC, prevalence, training-derived threshold coverage and risk. All groups, four weather summaries. Retain MSP as the anchor for the original Fog gain.
metrics: Same full-resolution valid pixels, frozen CUDA feature extraction from verified native logits, frozen 100000 arcsine-sqrt bins, whole-bin nearest attainable target (first/lower on ties), right-step AURC. Exact counts for each selected set and transferred training threshold. No segmentation forwards.
night: Three individual groups. Focus on accepted risk and error count at 10% retrospective coverage, with 1%, 5% and 20% for context. Record attained coverage, number accepted, total errors and errors predicted as vegetation. Same-coverage sensitivity: expected error at the same accepted pixel count with fractional label-independent acceptance of the boundary bin, plus the prior raw-score shared QA sample with seed-806 secondary tie keys.
fog: Six individual groups and their unweighted mean near 80% retrospective coverage. Compare interaction against LR + Class and raw MSP; report original/new gain versus MSP, how many groups improve, and any deterioration relative to LR + Class. Descriptive retention, no formal equivalence/noninferiority margin.
scope: Single exploratory model family. Keep adverse outcomes, correlated pixels and filename proxy limitations explicit.
